name: binary-upgrade
description: An opted-in kollab binary launched normally (daemon + attached window) installs the newer release a local release server offers, restarts as it before anything starts, and chats; /upgrade then reports it up to date. Fixture: tests/tmux/lib/binary_upgrade_fixture.sh.

steps.title: two binaries and a release server

steps.description: build this version and the next one, serve the next one
steps.command: R=$(pwd); P="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-binary-upgrade.path"; [ -s "$P" ] && O=$(cat "$P") && { kill "$(cat "$O/server.pid")" "$(cat "$O/home/fake.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true; }; D=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-binary-upgrade.XXXXXX"); printf %s "$D" > "$P"; bash "$R/tests/tmux/lib/binary_upgrade_fixture.sh" "$D"

steps.title: the launch installs the release and restarts into it

steps.description: the installed binary is the new release
steps.command: D=$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-binary-upgrade.path"); V=$(HOME="$D/home" "$D/bin/kollab" --version | awk '{print $NF}'); test "$V" = "$(cat "$D/new-version")" && echo "installed binary is v$V"

steps.title: it works and knows it is current

steps.description: stop the agent, the release server and the fake model
steps.command: D=$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-binary-upgrade.path"); (cd "$D/home/ws" && HOME="$D/home" "$D/bin/kollab" --hub stop all >/dev/null 2>&1); kill "$(cat "$D/server.pid")" "$(cat "$D/home/fake.pid")" 2>/dev/null; true
